categories.label: 近义词
categories.traits: Existing word in literary passage; asks meaning as used; synonym options.

categories.label: 词汇填空
categories.traits: Passage has word/phrase blank; asks logical precise vocabulary; lexical options.

categories.label: 全文结构
categories.traits: Whole passage progression; asks overall structure; sequential rhetorical descriptions.

categories.label: 全文修辞目的
categories.traits: Whole passage intention; asks main purpose; To discuss/explain/describe options.

categories.label: 句子修辞目的
categories.traits: Underlined sentence within passage; asks function; role relative to surrounding claims.

categories.label: 双篇
categories.traits: Text 1 and Text 2; compares perspectives or common topic; relational statements.

categories.label: 主旨题
categories.traits: Whole-passage focus; asks main topic or main idea; broad summary options.

categories.label: 细节题
categories.traits: Specific textual information; reference stem says most strongly suggest; classify by evidence task, not suggest keyword alone.

categories.label: 文本证据之引用题
categories.traits: Claim/finding plus request for an illustrating quotation; quotations as choices.

categories.label: 文本证据之增强削弱
categories.traits: Claim plus hypothetical finding; asks support or weaken; evidence statements.

categories.label: 数量证据之填空
categories.traits: Table or graph plus sentence blank; asks accurate data completion; numerical comparisons. Reference says graph but contains a table.

categories.label: 数量证据之增强削弱
categories.traits: Table or graph plus claim; asks data supporting or weakening claim; numerical comparisons.

categories.label: 推断题
categories.traits: Observations lead to conclusion blank; asks logical completion; full inferential conclusions, not vocabulary.

categories.label: 连接句子
categories.traits: Clause boundary blank; Standard English stem; punctuation and conjunction alternatives.

categories.label: 修饰语
categories.traits: Noun/title modifier; Standard English stem; paired comma and restrictive/nonrestrictive alternatives.

categories.label: 谓语与非谓语
categories.traits: Sentence lacks main verb; Standard English stem; finite verb vs infinitive/participle alternatives.

categories.label: 主谓一致
categories.traits: Subject plus verb blank; Standard English stem; singular/plural verb alternatives.

categories.label: 时态
categories.traits: Temporal context and verb blank; Standard English stem; past/present/future/perfect alternatives.

categories.label: 逻辑主语一致
categories.traits: Opening modifier; Standard English stem; reordered subjects identify logical referent.

categories.label: 代词、名词及所有格
categories.traits: Antecedent and noun/pronoun blank; Standard English stem; number, reference, possession or apostrophe alternatives.

categories.label: 逻辑词
categories.traits: Related sentences with transition blank; most logical transition; discourse connector phrases.

categories.label: 修辞综合
categories.traits: Bullet research notes plus explicit rhetorical goal; asks relevant information to accomplish goal; synthesized sentences.
